name: Maid-san
source:
As the Demon King's ever-present, all-purpose maid who handles everything flawlessly, she supports the Hero-kun's lewd quests.

She does things at her own pace, never really listening to others, and her useless advice only adds fuel to the fire.

Though she possesses certain things the Demon King has, she's someone who can easily handle someone like the Hero.

[From [url=https://erectlip.amusecraft.com/product24.html#character]official site[/url]]
